run_render_pipeline: run the render CLI to render objects from a trained autoencoder using an experiment config file
run_render_with_profiler: run the render pipeline with PyTorch profiler enabled and export a Chrome trace file
run_render_with_torchscript: run the render pipeline with TorchScript compilation enabled for the encoder and decoder
run_render_without_fuse: run the render pipeline skipping the model fusion step using the --nofuse flag
run_render_with_custom_batchsize: run the render pipeline with a custom batch size for rendering dataset items
